statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to capture and correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
